problem: A particle starts moving from the point with position vector $(2i+3j)\,\text{in}$ with a constant velocity of $-j\,\text{in/s}.$ Find the position vector of the particle after $4$ seconds.

feedback.worked_solution:
When a particle (or object) moves with constant velocity $u,$ the position vector at time $t$ is given by the equation

$$
r={r}_{0}+ut,
$$

where ${r}_{0}$ is the initial position vector.

In this case, the skier starts at the origin, so

$$
{r}_{0}=0i+0j,\,u=6i-1j.
$$

Therefore, the position vector of the skier after $t=5\,\text{s}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}r & ={r}_{0}+ut \\  & =(0i+0j)+(6i-1j)(5) \\  & =(\,30\,i-5\,j)\,\text{m}.\end{aligned}
$$
